01 // APPLE SILICON COMPUTE

Mac Studios, 24" iMacs & MacBook Pros

Our lab is powered by a dedicated fleet of Apple Mac Studios for heavy neural network training and 3D rendering, 24-inch Apple iMacs for collaborative CAD/CAM design, and MacBook Pros for live robotics arena telemetry.

  • Unified Memory Architecture for local AI model training
  • Multi-axis CAD/FEA structural simulation at 5K resolution

Enterprise-Grade Investment
02 // ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING

Industrial Multi-Material 3D Printing

Students don't wait weeks for parts or rely on snap-together toy kits. With enclosed high-speed CoreXY multi-material and carbon-fiber 3D printers, students fabricate custom gears, robotic grippers, and aerodynamic housings in hours.

  • Parametric CAD design to physical prototype within a single class
  • Carbon-fiber reinforced polymers, PLA-Pro, PETG & TPU flexibles
  • Iterative stress testing, tolerance engineering & DFM principles
Rapid Physical Fabrication
03 // AUTONOMOUS ROBOTICS

Embodied AI & Mechatronics Arena

Building upon Al-Manarat's acclaimed Robotics Club & Horizon STEM Lab, AIR Labs merges mechanical engineering, custom electronics, LIDAR SLAM navigation, and computer vision into physical robots that perceive and act.

  • 6-axis articulated robotic arms & omni-directional holonomic rovers
  • Sensor fusion: 360° LIDAR, depth cameras, IMUs & edge microcontrollers
  • Provincial & national robotics competition readiness
Hardware + AI Integration
Why Al-Manarat High School

Seamlessly Integrating Islamic Values with Ontario's #1 Academic Excellence Since 2006

Founded in 2006 by Mrs. Nasreen Ali in a small basement with just 7 students, our journey has been marked by an unwavering commitment to nurturing the spiritual, moral, intellectual, social, and emotional growth of our students in light of the Qur'an and the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).

The Al-Manarat advantage lies in our unique curriculum that intertwines Ontario's educational standards (OSSD) with a comprehensive Islamic education—fostering well-rounded, career-driven, and confident young adults. Our dedicated staff, long-term student-teacher relationships, and emphasis on practical builder skills ensure our graduates are prepared for both worldly leadership and spiritual fulfillment.

01
God-Oriented

“Taqwa” — Consciousness

Taqwa is being aware that Allah is aware of us, and being adamant on benefitting from every opportunity to earn Allah's pleasure through ethical action and service.

02
Excellence Driven

“Itqan” — Precision Mastery

Completing every task—from Qur'anic recitation to neural network engineering—in the most focused and precise manner, rooted in discipline, grit, and perseverance.

03
Stewardship & Responsibility

“Amanah” — Sacred Trust

“Those who fulfill their commitment whenever they commit.” Nurturing students to fulfill their commitments to Allah, the Prophet (pbuh), family, community, and Ummah.

04
Character Focused

“Akhlaaq” — Comportment

Restoring comportment into education through compassion and wisdom—training charismatic leaders, prolific thinkers, and principled builders.

Institutional Trajectory

Our Journey: From 7 Students in a Basement to Ontario's #1 High School & AIR Labs

2006 — 2026
2006 – 2012
The Seed of Al-Manarat

Founded by Mrs. Nasreen Ali in a basement with 7 students; registered as Al-Manarat Academy in 2012.

2016 – 2019
Full-Time School & Hifz

Founded Al-Manarat Heights Islamic School at Derry & Argentia Rd (Casa to Grade 8) with expanded Hifz & youth programs.

2021 – 2022
High School & OSSD Approval

Approved by the Ontario Ministry of Education to grant credits toward the Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD).

2023 – 2025
Ranked #1 in Ontario

Expanded through Grade 12 across 18,000 sq. ft. and ranked #1 High School in Ontario by the Fraser Institute.

2026 & BEYOND
Launch of AIR Labs

Uniting Apple Mac Studios, iMacs, MacBooks, 3D printing, and AI robotics to empower a generation of builders.

Curriculum Integration

The 4-Year Student Builder Progression (Grades 9 to 12)

Every Al-Manarat student progresses from foundational computational thinking and CAD in Grade 9 to autonomous AI-robotics capstones and Co-Op placements by Grade 12.

GRADE 09

Foundations of CAD, Code & Fabrication

Parametric 3D modeling on 24" iMacs, slicing and printing first mechanical assemblies on CoreXY 3D printers, Python fundamentals, and mobile robotics sensors.

GRADE 10

Mechatronics, Kinematics & Embedded C++/Python

Designing multi-degree-of-freedom robotic actuators, custom carbon-fiber 3D printed chassis, microcontroller telemetry via MacBooks, and VEX/FIRST competition engineering.

GRADE 11

Applied AI, Computer Vision & Neural Compute

Training neural networks on Apple Mac Studios, deploying real-time object detection and LIDAR SLAM navigation onto autonomous rovers and articulated arms.

GRADE 12

Sovereign Builder Capstone & STEM Co-Op

Full-year engineering thesis solving a real community, healthcare, or environmental challenge—paired with university-level portfolio defense and AP/Co-Op placement.
